fire-rescue.name: Fire & Rescue
fire-rescue.tagline: Integrated fire rescue training facilities for fire departments, brigades, and training bases — live-fire base construction and multi-scenario operational training.
intro: Fire and rescue teams face the broadest training requirements — from high-rise firefighting and interior search to CFBT live fire and hazmat response. Facilities must withstand high-frequency, high-temperature use while supporting diverse training objectives.
TZJ delivers turnkey training bases — from fixed towers and burn rooms to specialized scenarios — designed to NFPA and relevant GB standards, balancing realism with long-term durability.

focus.title: Live-Fire Capability
focus.desc: Interlocking liner burn rooms and CFBT systems for controlled, repeatable high-heat training.

focus.title: High-Rise & Interior Attack
focus.desc: Multi-story towers replicate high-rise buildings for ladder work, interior search, and self-rescue.

focus.title: Hazmat Response
focus.desc: Instructor props and mobile trailers recreate leak, plug, and decontamination scenarios.

focus.title: Long-Term Reliability
focus.desc: Hot-dip galvanized steel plus annual inspections for decades of safe service.
